reply_text:
@Gideon Sato, from the #inc-vtg-hartford history:

- **First report:** your post at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**: gate kiosks offline at the Hartford plant, both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan. I found nothing earlier in the channel.
- **The guard:** per your 10:42 post, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.
- **In the meantime:** Mateo reported six trucks waiting at the east gate at 10:44. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it. Your 11:08 post says both lanes were working as of 11:07.

The thread doesn't say more about what the guard did between 10:42 and 11:03. For that, Mateo or the site would be the people to ask. Also, my search of the channel is keyword-based and returned one indexed page, so if there were messages outside that page, I couldn't see them.
